name: Préleveuse de citerne
description: Small-framed agile adult female Yautja, slim limbs, densely spotted yellow-brown skin, high compact head crest, short tied-back dreadlocks, unmasked face with clearly alien mandibles. Sand-coloured long tunic with side openings over dark fitted knee trousers, rolled sleeves, narrow tool belt and one shoulder harness. Holds a squat sealed blue-glass collection jar by its handle, other hand holding a short sampling dipper tucked close to body. Gentle bent elbow, alert posture.
